_about: Settings for scripts/mods_crosswalk.py. One entry per source; edit values here rather than in the script. Keys starting with _ are comments.
record_content_source: University of Northern Iowa. Rod Library

scholarworks.repository: University of Northern Iowa. Rod Library. UNI ScholarWorks
scholarworks._include_external: Digital Commons also exposes a few hundred records from other institutions' repositories (UNI-affiliated works). false (the default) = leave them out; true = include them.

archivesspace._note_types: ArchivesSpace MODS note and accessCondition types. drop_note_types are left out (preferredcitation is a fill-in-the-blanks template); the others decide which template column an accessCondition goes to.
archivesspace.repository_prefix: University of Northern Iowa. Rod Library. Special Collections & University Archives

preservica.repository: University of Northern Iowa. Rod Library. Special Collections & University Archives
preservica._item_url: Public link for each asset/folder. {kind} is IO or SO, {uuid} the Preservica reference. Check one against uni.access.preservica.com; set to "" to leave links out.
preservica._skip_titles: Folders with these titles are structural (not described items): left out, and skipped over when finding a record's parent collection.

museumplus.repository: University of Northern Iowa. Museums & Collections
museumplus._item_url: Public link on collections.uni.edu. {id} is the MuseumPlus record ID (__id). Left blank until the pattern is confirmed.

archiveit.repository: University of Northern Iowa. Rod Library. Special Collections & University Archives
